jobs.description:
Your role as Team Manager Value Management
 
 

• You define the Value Management strategy and roadmap for Business Solutions, focused on retention, renewals and gross margin protection. 

• You identify the main drivers of churn, revenue erosion and value leakage, and translate data and customer insights into high-impact actions. 

• You connect customer outcomes with financial impact and balance customer needs with sustainable value creation. 

• You drive a cross-functional value agenda across Product & Journey, Commercial, Delivery & Services and Operations, securing ownership and commitment. 

• You build and lead a multidisciplinary team, set priorities and develop its analytical, commercial and influencing capabilities. 

• You establish governance, KPIs and decision forums that make customer value and gross margin visible in business decisions. 

• You determine priorities and trade-offs, monitor progress and intervene when delivery or impact stalls.  

Your profile as Team Manager Value Management
 
 

• You hold a master’s degree or have equivalent experience. 

• You have at least 5 years of relevant experience in Value Management, Customer Lifecycle Management, Retention, CX, Commercial Strategy or Business Transformation within a complex B2B environment, including 2 years in a leadership role. 

• You understand the commercial and financial drivers behind retention, renewals and gross margin and translate them into clear business choices. 

• You build coalitions, negotiate priorities and create ownership beyond your own team, including without direct authority. 

• You combine strategic and analytical thinking with the ability to set direction in situations of ambiguity and incomplete information. 

• You are decisive and outcome-oriented, and comfortably balance customer needs, commercial ambitions and organizational realities. 

• You are a compelling communicator and mature people leader who influences senior stakeholders and develops multidisciplinary teams. You are fluent in English; Dutch is a strong asset.

Satellit is seeking an experienced .NET developer with Java know-how to join a multi-disciplinary team delivering digital identity and authentication capabilities for a major energy-sector engagement. The role involves building, validating and documenting reusable authentication/authorization components, contributing to deployment automation, collaborating with IT stakeholders, and participating in agile squad activities. This position follows a hybrid work model with an expectation of being on-site about two days per week and is planned to start in the mid-October to mid-November timeframe. Full-time commitment is required.
Who are you?

What will you do?

• Design, implement, unit-test and document libraries, services or components that handle user authentication and authorization.

• Create example applications and code samples to illustrate how to integrate identity and access services into new or existing systems, and communicate these to engineering teams.

• Customize and extend commercial or open-source products (for example access managers, authorization engines, API gateways, reverse proxies and directory services) and produce supporting documentation for those extensions.

• Improve and automate continuous integration and continuous delivery workflows, including configuration and release automation.

• Work closely with IT and application teams to identify integration points, diagnose issues, and resolve problems when connecting to identity fabric services.

• Install and configure third-party and open-source components by following technical guides and producing any required deployment notes.

• Take part in squad sprint activities, including planning, execution and retrospective work.

• Own assigned backlog items, drive tasks to completion and report progress to the squad.

• Prepare for and actively participate in meetings and workshops, tracking actions and follow-ups.

• Propose technical solutions that align with requirements and constraints, present them to stakeholders and refine based on feedback.

• Continuously acquire new technical knowledge, standards and tooling needed to fulfill assigned work.

Preferred Qualifications:

• Practical knowledge of Java and familiarity with interoperation between Java and .NET components.

The employer is a dynamic and growing organisation operating within a modern commercial and operational environment. Bringing together various services, activities and partners on one site, the company relies on strong internal coordination to ensure smooth day-to-day functioning. To support this mission, it is looking for an Office Manager who will play a key role in the operational and administrative management of the location.

Jobomschrijving

The Office Manager acts as a central point of coordination for the Technical Director and supports various operational teams across the shopping centre.

Administrative Management
 She/he manages internal and external communications, prepares and reviews documents, maintains updated tenant information, circulates weekly footfall data to the Landlord, the Property Manager and the internal team, and organises meetings and conferences. She/he also manages agendas, appointments and administrative workflows.

Coordination
 She/he collaborates closely with internal departments, external partners and tenants to ensure fluid communication and the smooth running of ongoing projects. Responsibilities include drafting meeting minutes, monitoring deadlines, managing office supplies, and overseeing the Info Desk schedule, orders and administrative tasks, including basic support with SUMUP-related matters.

Reception & Customer Relations
 As a representative of the shopping centre, she/he welcomes visitors, partners and clients in a warm and professional manner and provides clear, accurate information regarding the centre's services and activities.

Information Management
 She/he maintains all records, files and databases, ensures confidentiality and data security, oversees the publication and updates of House Rules on Chainels and manages internal communication such as "What's Up" on Chainels.

Support to Management
 She/he assists the Facility Manager with follow-up on files such as security and insurance, prepares ad hoc reports and summaries to support decision-making and provides occasional support to the marketing team when needed.

The ideal candidate demonstrates professionalism, discretion and strong organisational abilities.

Key criteria include:

• A flexible and hands-on approach.
• A degree in Business Administration, Secretarial Studies or a related field.
• Previous experience in an Executive Assistant, Office Manager or similar role; experience in a shopping-centre environment is a strong asset.
• Excellent organisational, prioritisation and time-management skills.
• Strong proficiency in MS Office and digital tools.
• Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
• Ability to work autonomously, anticipate needs and take initiative.
• High level of discretion and a proactive mindset.
• Fluency in French, Dutch and English.
